intro: 🌙 EVENING EDITION! Tuesday had it all: a proud book announcement on BOTH platforms, a rhyming GM roll call, a fresh $LPTH add, a lunchtime free-rent roast of @lordwilmehr, and a salute to peak chonky-cat fitness. What a day to be a fan. 📚🔥🐈

items.caption: 🔥 ROAST OF THE DAY! When @WillPrompting's thread turned to free rent, our guy pointed out that @lordwilmehr has been getting free rent his whole life. Somebody call the fire department. 🚒
items.quote: @WillPrompting @Molson_Hart @JeffBezos @blueorigin @lordwilmehr been getting free rent his whole life.

items.caption: 🐈 Chonky cat appreciation hour! He quote-posted a big ol' 'chonk' and called it what it is: peak feline physical fitness. Absolute unit, absolute legend.
items.quote: This is peak feline physical fitness

items.caption: 📚 PROUD AUTHOR ALERT! Our guy says his book will really help people, and he's not hiding the pride. We love to see it.

items.caption: Preorders selling out quick?! He's asking the real question: what does your life after trading look like? Let KansasCash help keep food on the table. 🍽️

items.caption: 🎤 GM roll call, delivered in rhyme! KC's in the house and the $SPY board is told to jump, jump, rejoice. Morning hype unlocked.
